posts.title: Canada's Antifōn Audio delivers compelling Ternion 3-Stage Cascaded Discrete Transistor Drive and Fuzz
posts.description: Canadian builders have quite the knack for creating interesting and compelling gain circuits, and this Ternion is another great example of that - combining both Drive and Fuzz voicings in the same unit - presumably by engaging a further Gain Stage. Controls - Master Gain, Master Level, Bass (15Hz > 175Hz), Treble : LPF to -500Hz, Mids : -850Hz Notch Filter, HPF : 33Hz > 240Hz > 330Hz > 500Hz, Fuzz

posts.title: Talisman Audio's thunderous, glitchy Sziklai-Pair 6-Transistor Sub-Octave Fuzz is not for the faint-of-heart
